SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressList */ CH.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CH.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, CASE WHEN CH.COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' THEN '납품완료' ELSE CASE WHEN CH.BL_COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' THEN 'B/L생성' ELSE 'C/I, P/L생성' END END AS STATUS, CH.CI_NO, CH.CI_DATE, BD.BL_NO, BD.BL_SEQ, CH.FORWARDER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP01' AND CODE = CH.FORWARDER) AS FORWARDER_NAME, CH.SHIP_METHOD, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP02' AND CODE = CH.SHIP_METHOD) AS SHIP_METHOD_NAME, CH.CURRENCY_CODE, CH.ITEM_AMT, CH.TOTAL_WEIGHT, CH.CI_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(CH.CI_IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS CI_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, BH.IMAGE_KEY AS BL_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(BH.IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS BL_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, CH.EXP_REPORT_DATE, CH.EXP_SHIP_DATE, CH.ENTRY_EXCHANGE_RATE, CH.IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(CH.IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS IMAGE_KEY_IMG, 6 AS CI_SHEET, 6 AS PL_SHEET, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_EXP_LOT_INFO WHERE PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND BUYER = CH.BUYER AND CI_NO = CH.CI_NO AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R')), 0, 4, 5) AS LOT_IMG, CH.BL_COMPLETE_MARK, CH.COMPLETE_MARK, BH.RESULT_MSG, DECODE(BH.RESULT_FLAG, 'CONFIRM', '고객사승인', 'REJECT', '고객사반려') AS RESULT_STATUS, BH.RESULT_FLAG, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(BH.RESULT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RESULT_DATE, BH.BUYER_SHIPPING_NO FROM KEP_EXP_CIHD CH, KEP_EXP_BLDT BD, KEP_EXP_BLHD BH WHERE 1=1 AND CH.BUYER = BD.BUYER(+) AND CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE(+) AND CH.CI_NO = BD.CI_NO(+)
AND BD.BUYER = BH.BUYER(+) AND BD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE(+) AND BD.BL_NO = BH.BL_NO(+)
AND CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND CH.CI_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND CH.STATUS IN ('C', 'R')
AND CH.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND CH.CI_NO LIKE #{st_ci_no} || '%'
AND BD.BL_NO LIKE #{st_bl_no} || '%'
AND BD.BL_NO IS NULL
AND CH.BL_COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' AND CH.COMPLETE_MARK = 'N'
AND CH.COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y'
ORDER BY CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE, CH.BUYER, CH.CI_NO
